title: Per-route capture-latency scan with within-method mix-shift corroboration
hypothesis: route_latency is missed because the merchant-wide latency z-score never fires (sparse early-morning buckets + leading-baseline poisoning — measured in exp000, NOT 'a route barely moves the aggregate': the aggregate mean rises 6-10x but the chart stays silent). A per-route slice series (15-min buckets, count floor 3) sees the incident starkly; scoring slices only when the merchant-wide pass admits nothing avoids duplicate incidents on fleet-wide latency events.

dataset.ground_truth: route_latency 2026-08-13T03:30..05:30Z, pg_primary, latency x8, affected INR 51,727 (recoverable=False)

feature_version: signals v2 (final): route in payment_segments/SEGMENT_DIMENSIONS; _scan_latency_routes on capture_latency_ms; slice grid 15 min (x3), slice min_bucket_count 3, detector zscore z>=3, standard floors (75ms, vol 15, run 2) + within-method corroboration (>=2 methods with >=3 samples both regions rising >=2x; lone method >=3x)
model_version: detectors unchanged (zscore production default); engine scan constants LATENCY_ROUTE_SCAN_ENABLED=True, LATENCY_SCAN_BUCKET_MULTIPLIER=3, LATENCY_SCAN_MIN_BUCKET_COUNT=3, LATENCY_SCAN_MAX_SLICE_SHARE=0.95
